tables.name: DIM_DATE
tables.description: Calendar dimension with fiscal year support for Pakistan FBR reporting periods (July-June fiscal year).

columns.name: is_ramadan
columns.description: True if date falls within Ramadan

tables.name: DIM_TRADER
tables.description: Trader/importer/exporter dimension including FBR NTN registration, AEO tier, and compliance profile.

columns.name: ntn_number
columns.description: National Tax Number assigned by FBR

columns.name: type
columns.description: Trader type: importer, exporter, clearing_agent, manufacturer

columns.name: province
columns.description: Province of registration (Punjab, Sindh, KP, Balochistan, ICT, GB, AJK)

columns.name: aeo_tier
columns.description: Authorized Economic Operator tier (Tier-1, Tier-2, Tier-3, None)

columns.name: ata_chapter_user
columns.description: Whether trader uses ATA Carnet chapters

columns.name: risk_category
columns.description: Current risk category: low, medium, high, very_high

columns.name: total_gds_last_12m
columns.description: Count of GDs filed in last 12 months

tables.name: DIM_COMMODITY
tables.description: Commodity classification dimension based on Pakistan Customs Tariff (PCT) and WCO Harmonized System.

columns.name: pct_code
columns.description: Pakistan Customs Tariff code (8-digit national tariff line)

columns.name: regulatory_duty_indicator
columns.description: Subject to regulatory duty under SRO

columns.name: fifth_schedule
columns.description: Listed in Fifth Schedule of Customs Act 1969

columns.name: unit_of_measure
columns.description: Standard unit (KGM, LTR, MTR, PCS, etc.)

tables.name: DIM_COUNTRY
tables.description: Country and trading partner dimension with FTA/PTA eligibility for Pakistan bilateral and multilateral agreements.

columns.name: fta_code
columns.description: Applicable FTA/PTA code (CPFTA, SAFTA, ECOTA, PAK-CHINA-II, etc.)

columns.name: trade_agreement
columns.description: Name of trade agreement with Pakistan

columns.name: risk_tier
columns.description: Country risk tier for customs: low, medium, high

tables.name: DIM_PORT
tables.description: Port and entry point dimension covering sea ports, airports, dry ports, and land border crossings in Pakistan.

columns.name: type
columns.description: Port type: seaport, airport, dry_port, land_border, inland_container_depot

columns.name: cpec_node
columns.description: Whether port is a CPEC corridor node

columns.name: atta_route
columns.description: Afghan Transit Trade Agreement route port

tables.name: DIM_CUSTOMS_STATION
tables.description: Customs stations and collectorates under FBR jurisdiction across Pakistan.

columns.name: collectorate
columns.description: Parent collectorate name (e.g. Model Customs Collectorate Karachi)

tables.name: DIM_TRANSPORT_MODE
tables.description: Transport mode dimension covering sea, air, road, rail, and multi-modal movements.

columns.name: avg_transit_days
columns.description: Average transit days for this mode

columns.name: cpec_corridor_mode
columns.description: Whether used on CPEC corridor routes

tables.name: DIM_AGENT
tables.description: Customs clearing agent and broker dimension licensed by Pakistan Customs.

columns.name: performance_tier
columns.description: Performance tier: gold, silver, bronze, standard

columns.name: clearances_last_12m
columns.description: Number of clearances handled in last 12 months

tables.name: DIM_GD_TYPE
tables.description: Goods Declaration type dimension covering all WeBOC GD categories and customs procedures.

columns.name: name
columns.description: GD type name (e.g. Home Consumption, Warehousing, Temporary Import)

columns.name: category
columns.description: Category: import, export, transit, warehouse, temporary, re-export

columns.name: atta_applicable
columns.description: Applicable under Afghan Transit Trade Agreement

tables.name: DIM_SRO
tables.description: Statutory Regulatory Order dimension tracking duty concessions and exemptions issued by FBR.

columns.name: type
columns.description: SRO type: exemption, concession, conditional, regulatory

columns.name: duty_type
columns.description: Duty type affected: customs_duty, regulatory_duty, additional_duty, sales_tax, withholding_tax

columns.name: issuing_authority
columns.description: Issuing authority (FBR, Ministry of Commerce, etc.)

columns.name: superseded_by
columns.description: SRO number that supersedes this one

tables.name: FACT_TRADE_TRANSACTION
tables.description: Central fact table recording every customs goods declaration transaction with duty amounts, weights, clearance metrics, and compliance indicators.

columns.name: date_key
columns.description: FK to DIM_DATE — date of GD registration

columns.name: clearance_date_key
columns.description: FK to DIM_DATE — date of goods release

columns.name: origin_country_key
columns.description: FK to DIM_COUNTRY — country of origin

columns.name: dest_country_key
columns.description: FK to DIM_COUNTRY — country of destination

columns.name: port_key
columns.description: FK to DIM_PORT — port of entry/exit

columns.name: transport_mode_key
columns.description: FK to DIM_TRANSPORT_MODE — mode of transport

columns.name: sro_key
columns.description: FK to DIM_SRO — applicable SRO concession

columns.name: bill_of_lading
columns.description: Bill of lading / airway bill number

columns.name: declared_value_pkr
columns.description: Declared customs value in Pakistani Rupees

columns.name: withholding_tax_pkr
columns.description: Withholding / advance income tax in PKR

columns.name: total_duty_pkr
columns.description: Total duties and taxes in PKR

columns.name: sro_concession_pkr
columns.description: Duty concession amount under SRO in PKR

columns.name: item_count
columns.description: Number of line items in the GD

columns.name: selectivity_channel
columns.description: Risk selectivity channel: green, yellow, red, blue

columns.name: examination_result
columns.description: Examination outcome: compliant, discrepancy, seizure, null

columns.name: clearance_time_minutes
columns.description: Total clearance time from registration to release in minutes

columns.name: cpec_route_flag
columns.description: Goods moved via CPEC corridor route

columns.name: aeo_status
columns.description: AEO status of trader at time of transaction

tables.name: AGG_DAILY_REVENUE
tables.description: Daily aggregated customs revenue by collectorate and duty type for FBR revenue monitoring.

columns.name: duty_type
columns.description: Duty type: customs_duty, regulatory_duty, sales_tax, withholding_tax, fed

columns.name: sro_concession_total_pkr
columns.description: Total SRO concessions applied in PKR

columns.name: target_revenue_pkr
columns.description: FBR daily revenue target in PKR

columns.name: avg_duty_per_gd_pkr
columns.description: Average duty per GD in PKR

tables.name: AGG_MONTHLY_TRADE
tables.description: Monthly aggregated trade volumes by commodity and country for trade balance analysis.

columns.name: total_duty_pkr
columns.description: Total duties and taxes in PKR

columns.name: fta_utilization_pct
columns.description: Percentage of transactions claiming FTA preference

tables.name: AGG_QUARTERLY_COMPLIANCE
tables.description: Quarterly compliance metrics by collectorate for FBR performance reporting.

columns.name: discrepancy_rate
columns.description: Rate of discrepancies found on examination

columns.name: post_audit_recovery_pkr
columns.description: Revenue recovered through post-clearance audit in PKR

tables.name: AGG_PORT_PERFORMANCE
tables.description: Port throughput and dwell time aggregations for trade facilitation benchmarking.

columns.name: congestion_flag
columns.description: Whether port experienced congestion in period

views.name: VW_TRADE_BALANCE
views.description: Summarizes import vs export values by country and commodity to calculate trade balance, trade deficit, and terms-of-trade indicators.

views.name: VW_REVENUE_LEAKAGE
views.description: Identifies potential revenue leakage by comparing declared values against reference prices, highlighting under-invoicing, misclassification, and SRO misuse.

views.name: VW_CLEARANCE_SLA
views.description: Tracks clearance time against SLA targets by port, collectorate, and channel, flagging SLA breaches and bottlenecks.

views.name: VW_RISK_EFFECTIVENESS
views.description: Measures the hit rate and effectiveness of risk-based selectivity channels by comparing examination outcomes against channel assignments.

views.name: VW_FTA_UTILIZATION
views.description: Analyzes FTA/PTA preference utilization rates by agreement, country, and commodity to identify under-utilized concessions and trade diversion.

views.name: VW_CPEC_TRADE
views.description: Dedicated view for CPEC corridor trade flows showing volumes, values, and transit times along CPEC route ports and dry ports.
